column1: # Rows db.dlm.ps.*, db.dlm.rps.*, db.dlm.rpst.*, db.dlm.bp.* and db.dlm.tbnp.* (line RG, series F, item D-36 and its reviews 1 and 1b): psiblast's, rpsblast's and rpstblastn's custom delimiter (-outfmt "6|7|10|20 delim=X ..."), which their applications never hand to the formatter (psiblast_app.cpp:501-505, rpsblast_app.cpp:186-189, rpstblastn_app.cpp:183-186: no SetCustomDelimiter, which blastp_app.cpp:249 calls): NCBI 2.17.0 writes the format's own delimiter (the comma of outfmt 10 and 20 and their header line, the tab of 6 and 7; `6 delim=@` and `7 delim=,` are the default reports, whose identities rpsblast counts on the letters as read) and still checks delim= against the fields (s_ValidateCustomDelim, rc 1, before LOSAT's refusal of rpsblast's and rpstblastn's outfmt 20, item PS15a); a format number with a leading zero or a plus sign (`06`, `+6`, `00`: NStr::StringToInt, blast_args.cpp:2829) and the words after outfmt 0 to 4, which NCBI drops (blast_args.cpp:2845-2851), on the command line and in the library, blastp's rows (db.dlm.bp.*) too; outfmt 13 and 14 without -out: NCBI's `Please provide a file name` (UseXInclude, blast_app_util.cpp:888-899; none after `Query is Empty!`) before LOSAT's refusals of psiblast's, rpsblast's and PSI-TBLASTN's outfmt 13 and 14 (items PS15a, PS15b); FASTA queries of tests/fasta/psiblast/ against tests/db_search/paja (one and two rounds, no hit, a database without sequences, an empty query file), the PSSMs tests/fixtures/pssm/ps4_tk_paja.asn.gz (outfmt 6 and 7: LOSAT refuses its 10 and 20, item PS15b) and ps7_ts1_tslice.asn.gz (PSI-TBLASTN against tests/db_search/tslice) and the scaled PSSM that NCBI stops at after the prolog; rpsblast's and rpstblastn's against rps_mini (outfmt 20 only with a delimiter that its fields use: LOSAT's RPS programs refuse it otherwise). The command line and the library read one rule (report::tabular::TabularSpec::of_app; app::ncbi_refuses_format); probes F/d36/probe of remaining-gaps-20261112.
